name: Stormbringer: Unrelenting Winds and Wicked Storms native modifiers (#732, #1322)
contract: #732: Unrelenting Winds (704211) is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effect, EffectMiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (SpellDefines.h:83), EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = +15, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 131072, 0] (dword1 bit17, 0x20000). All checked Gale ranks (570138-570141, 804036) carry SpellFamilyFlags [16384, 537001984, 136]; 537001984 = 0x20020000 has bit17 set, so 0x20000 & 0x20020000 != 0 and SpellInfo::IsAffected (SpellInfo.cpp:1437-1448, no family-22 override block) matches. Aura 107/108 route through AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:110), the stock flat-spellmod path consumed by Player::ApplySpellMod wherever a spell reads its own SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, which is exactly what the harness's spell_modifier metric queries directly with op 7. #1322: Wicked Storms (705650) is a single SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) effect, EffectMiscValue 8 = SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NATURE, EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = +5, no class mask (school-wide). AuraEffect::HandleModDamagePercentDone (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5183) is the standard +X% school-damage aura, read back by spell_damage_done's own native damage calculation on any Nature spell (Call Lightning 500040, SchoolMask 8). Neither passive has any module code; both close as regression scenarios only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: no crit-chance modifier on Gale before Unrelenting Winds
DISCRIMINATING: Unrelenting Winds adds +15 to Gale's crit-chance modifier
BASELINE: Call Lightning damage on the fixture target before Wicked Storms
DISCRIMINATING: Wicked Storms raises Call Lightning's damage by 5%
